cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Orbital mechanics, vortex particle fields, and undamped oscillating cameras requiring long-term energy bounds
Explaining why Explicit Euler det(M) = 1 + (ωΔt)² > 1 pumps unphysical energy every frame
Reusing end-of-step acceleration a_{n+1} so Velocity-Verlet costs only 1 force evaluation per step
Time-reversible physics animations that can be scrubbed forward and backward
not_for: Barnes-Hut or Fast Multipole O(N log N) gravitational tree codes
Heavily damped stiff parabolic diffusion PDEs requiring implicit backward Euler
Discontinuous rigid-body impact resolution with inelastic restitution
